LESSON: TAWAKKUL

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.3: Tawakkul

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Tawakkul
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: which Muslims can practise tawakkul in their daily life. 1. How can a Muslim show reliance on Allah?
